quarterly_data.signal: Eversource's consolidated capital expenditures totaled $1.97 billion in the first half of 2026, compared to $2.15 billion in the first half of 2025, primarily for projects to maintain and improve infrastructure including transmission and distribution reliability; electric transmission capital expenditures decreased by $5.6 million versus the first half of 2025. Cash investments in property, plant and equipment were $2.02 billion for Eversource, $511.5 million for CL&P, $773.8 million for NSTAR Electric and $197.4 million for PSNH.
